description: Instagram profile lookup: followers, bio, category, verified, engagement rate, avg likes/comments/views, posting cadence, recent posts, follower history and 30-day growth where tracked. Use to get public numbers for an Instagram account: followers, engagement rate, how often it posts and its recent posts. Returns name, bio, verified, category, followers, following, posts, metrics {engagementRate, avgLikes, avgComments, avgViews, postsPerWeek, tier}, recentPosts[], and for tracked accounts history[] and growth30d. Private or missing profiles fail and are not charged. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails.

handle.description: Handle (with or without @) or profile URL, e.g. virat.kohli, https://www.tiktok.com/@khaby.lame, @MrBeast or a YouTube channel id (UC...)

maxAgeHours.description: Oldest data you accept, 1-720 hours (default 72). Fresher than that is fetched live

name: social_instagram

fetchedAt.description: When the data was captured, ISO 8601

growth30d.description: Follower change over about 30 days; null without history

history.description: Past snapshots, oldest first (Instagram index weekly; other accounts once a day at most, from lookups)

recentPosts.description: Empty when served from the creator index

title: Instagram profile lookup
